correctedOverclaim.corrected: The frozen carrier physically admits 8 of the 9 current schema-3 operational record types. The incompatible cases are exactly: the record type SEAL, and the machine platform ids linux-aarch64-gnu, linux-x86_64-gnu, macos-aarch64 on a GRANT. It is therefore wrong to say no current operational record is physically writable.
correctedOverclaim.defect: Overbroad. Eight of the nine schema-3 operational record types insert cleanly, and a GRANT carrying macos-x86_64 inserts cleanly because that value is its own display alias.
correctedOverclaim.v3Wording: So the current logical journal cannot be written to any inherited physical carrier at all
